title: Flashers on the Strip
hook: The Menace died on a strip that is not a lane.
scene: Last daylight rain on the Ribbon, still the valley floor. The sky is going — gray over the deck, streetlights the only lamps. The Menace has stopped on a squeeze: fog line on the left, Jersey on the right, flashers already talking. There is no pad. The travel lanes still own the wet. The door handle is right there. Nobody else is in the car.
decision: The car is dead on that strip. What do you do?

options.text: Get out and walk the Jersey so a driver can see you
options.result: One step puts you on the fog line. A pair of lamps is already too close to miss a person. The wall has no sidewalk. You left the only shell you had.

options.text: Stay in the car, stay belted, keep the flashers on
options.result: You stay clipped. The flashers keep talking. Traffic owns the wet deck and you stay a shape inside steel, not a body on the line. The strip is still not a lane.

options.text: Unbuckle and stand at the rear so they have a body to miss
options.result: The belt comes off. You are now the tallest thing on a strip the width of a plate. The next set of lamps has no time to choose a gap.

options.text: Cross the live lanes to the median where the shoulder looks wider
options.result: You step into three wet lanes at dusk. The median is a rumor past lamps that did not plan on a person. The car you left was already off the through.

debrief: If the car dies on a narrow highway shoulder, stay inside and stay belted. Flashers tell the deck you are there. Do not stand on the fog line. Ali stays clipped behind the mesh.

source.psdp_skill: Skill eleven: highway driving – part two
source.teaching_target: Highway disablement on a narrow shoulder: stay in the vehicle, stay belted, flashers on. Do not stand on the fog line.

image_brief.midground: faded-pink Beetle stopped, flashers lit, Ali alone inside and belted; stock rear, no rear plow; heading away past a readable curve

extra_negatives: no shoulder wider than the deck plate
no dead-straight deck with no readable curve
no rear-mounted plow or rear blade
no interior rearview as the subject

geometry.ego_lane_side: narrow right shoulder, car near the travel-lane fog line
geometry.ego_nose_in_frame: three-quarter rear; stock engine lid nearest; plow far ahead if seen
